title: Referrals
codeOnceWarning: You can only change your code once, so choose carefully.
codeUsedNote: You've already changed your code. It can't be changed again.
codeInvalid: Use only a-z, 0-9, dot, dash and underscore.
codeTakenBody: That referral code is already in use. Try another.
referrerNote: Enter the code of whoever invited you. This can only be done once.
referrerSetNote: You were referred by this code.
referrerInvalidBody: We couldn't find that referral code. Check it and try again.
referrerSelfBody: You can't refer yourself. Enter someone else's code.
